<UserControl xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml/presentation" xmlns:x="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml" xmlns:iconPacks="http://metro.mahapps.com/winfx/xaml/iconpacks" x:Class="AccountingAutomationHub.Desktop.Views.DashboardView" Loaded="DashboardView_Loaded" Unloaded="DashboardView_Unloaded" PreviewMouseDown="DashboardView_PreviewMouseDown">
    <UserControl.Resources>
        <Style x:Key="DashboardSecondaryButtonStyle" TargetType="Button">
            <Setter Property="Background" Value="{DynamicResource SurfaceBrush}"/>
            <Setter Property="Foreground" Value="{DynamicResource TextPrimaryBrush}"/>
            <Setter Property="BorderBrush" Value="{DynamicResource BorderBrush}"/>
            <Setter Property="BorderThickness" Value="1"/>
            <Setter Property="Padding" Value="13,8"/>
            <Setter Property="FontWeight" Value="SemiBold"/>
            <Setter Property="Cursor" Value="Hand"/>
        </Style>
        <Style x:Key="AutoSyncPillToggleStyle" TargetType="{x:Type ToggleButton}">
            <Setter Property="Width" Value="50"/>
            <Setter Property="Height" Value="26"/>
            <Setter Property="Background" Value="#CBD5E1"/>
            <Setter Property="BorderThickness" Value="0"/>
            <Setter Property="Cursor" Value="Hand"/>
            <Setter Property="Focusable" Value="False"/>
            <Setter Property="Template">
                <Setter.Value>
                    <ControlTemplate TargetType="{x:Type ToggleButton}">
                        <Grid Width="{TemplateBinding Width}" Height="{TemplateBinding Height}">
                            <Border x:Name="Track" Background="{TemplateBinding Background}" CornerRadius="13"/>
                            <Border x:Name="Thumb" Width="20" Height="20" CornerRadius="10" Background="White" HorizontalAlignment="Left" Margin="3,0,0,0">
                                <Border.Effect><DropShadowEffect BlurRadius="3" ShadowDepth="1" Opacity="0.25"/></Border.Effect>
                            </Border>
                        </Grid>
                        <ControlTemplate.Triggers>
                            <Trigger Property="IsChecked" Value="True">
                                <Setter TargetName="Track" Property="Background" Value="#2563EB"/>
                                <Setter TargetName="Thumb" Property="HorizontalAlignment" Value="Right"/>
                                <Setter TargetName="Thumb" Property="Margin" Value="0,0,3,0"/>
                            </Trigger>
                            <Trigger Property="IsMouseOver" Value="True">
                                <Setter Property="Opacity" Value="0.92"/>
                            </Trigger>
                            <Trigger Property="IsEnabled" Value="False">
                                <Setter Property="Opacity" Value="0.45"/>
                            </Trigger>
                        </ControlTemplate.Triggers>
                    </ControlTemplate>
                </Setter.Value>
            </Setter>
        </Style>
        <Style x:Key="TallyMetricBorderStyle" TargetType="Border">
            <Setter Property="Width" Value="205"/>
            <Setter Property="MinHeight" Value="86"/>
            <Setter Property="Margin" Value="0,0,10,10"/>
            <Setter Property="Background" Value="{DynamicResource AppBackgroundBrush}"/>
            <Setter Property="BorderBrush" Value="{DynamicResource BorderBrush}"/>
            <Setter Property="BorderThickness" Value="1"/>
            <Setter Property="CornerRadius" Value="9"/>
            <Setter Property="Padding" Value="13"/>
            <Style.Triggers>
                <Trigger Property="IsMouseOver" Value="True">
                    <Setter Property="BorderBrush" Value="#93C5FD"/>
                    <Setter Property="Background" Value="#F8FBFF"/>
                </Trigger>
            </Style.Triggers>
        </Style>
        <Style x:Key="InnerCardStyle" TargetType="Border">
            <Setter Property="Background" Value="{DynamicResource AppBackgroundBrush}"/>
            <Setter Property="BorderBrush" Value="{DynamicResource BorderBrush}"/>
            <Setter Property="BorderThickness" Value="1"/>
            <Setter Property="CornerRadius" Value="10"/>
            <Setter Property="Padding" Value="15"/>
            <Style.Triggers>
                <Trigger Property="IsMouseOver" Value="True">
                    <Setter Property="BorderBrush" Value="#BFDBFE"/>
                    <Setter Property="Background" Value="#F8FBFF"/>
                </Trigger>
            </Style.Triggers>
        </Style>
        <Style x:Key="PeriodStatusTileStyle" TargetType="Border">
            <Setter Property="Background" Value="#F3F4F6"/>
            <Setter Property="BorderBrush" Value="#D1D5DB"/>
            <Setter Property="BorderThickness" Value="1"/>
            <Setter Property="CornerRadius" Value="8"/>
            <Setter Property="Padding" Value="8,7"/>
            <Setter Property="Margin" Value="3"/>
            <Setter Property="MinWidth" Value="64"/>
            <Style.Triggers>
                <DataTrigger Binding="{Binding StatusState}" Value="Green">
                    <Setter Property="Background" Value="#DCFCE7"/>
                    <Setter Property="BorderBrush" Value="#22C55E"/>
                </DataTrigger>
                <DataTrigger Binding="{Binding StatusState}" Value="Red">
                    <Setter Property="Background" Value="#FEE2E2"/>
                    <Setter Property="BorderBrush" Value="{DynamicResource ActionRequiredBrush}"/>
                </DataTrigger>
                <DataTrigger Binding="{Binding StatusState}" Value="Grey">
                    <Setter Property="Background" Value="#F3F4F6"/>
                    <Setter Property="BorderBrush" Value="#9CA3AF"/>
                </DataTrigger>
                <DataTrigger Binding="{Binding IsSelected}" Value="True">
                    <Setter Property="Background" Value="{DynamicResource TallySelectedPeriodBrush}"/>
                    <Setter Property="BorderBrush" Value="{DynamicResource TallySelectedPeriodBorderBrush}"/>
                    <Setter Property="BorderThickness" Value="1"/>
                </DataTrigger>
            </Style.Triggers>
        </Style>
        <Style x:Key="PeriodDisplayTileStyle" TargetType="Border">
            <Setter Property="Background" Value="#F3F4F6"/>
            <Setter Property="BorderBrush" Value="#D1D5DB"/>
            <Setter Property="BorderThickness" Value="1"/>
            <Setter Property="CornerRadius" Value="8"/>
            <Setter Property="Padding" Value="8,7"/>
            <Setter Property="Margin" Value="3"/>
            <Setter Property="MinWidth" Value="64"/>
            <Style.Triggers>
                <DataTrigger Binding="{Binding StatusState}" Value="Green">
                    <Setter Property="Background" Value="#DCFCE7"/>
                    <Setter Property="BorderBrush" Value="#22C55E"/>
                </DataTrigger>
                <DataTrigger Binding="{Binding StatusState}" Value="Red">
                    <Setter Property="Background" Value="#FEE2E2"/>
                    <Setter Property="BorderBrush" Value="#EF4444"/>
                </DataTrigger>
                <DataTrigger Binding="{Binding StatusState}" Value="Grey">
                    <Setter Property="Background" Value="#F3F4F6"/>
                    <Setter Property="BorderBrush" Value="#9CA3AF"/>
                </DataTrigger>
            </Style.Triggers>
        </Style>
        <Style x:Key="PeriodTileListBoxStyle" TargetType="ListBox">
            <Setter Property="Background" Value="Transparent"/>
            <Setter Property="BorderThickness" Value="0"/>
            <Setter Property="ScrollViewer.HorizontalScrollBarVisibility" Value="Disabled"/>
            <Setter Property="ScrollViewer.VerticalScrollBarVisibility" Value="Disabled"/>
            <Setter Property="SelectionMode" Value="Single"/>
        </Style>
        <Style x:Key="PeriodTileListBoxItemStyle" TargetType="ListBoxItem">
            <Setter Property="Padding" Value="0"/>
            <Setter Property="Margin" Value="0"/>
            <Setter Property="Background" Value="Transparent"/>
            <Setter Property="BorderThickness" Value="0"/>
            <Setter Property="HorizontalContentAlignment" Value="Stretch"/>
            <Setter Property="FocusVisualStyle" Value="{x:Null}"/>
            <Setter Property="Template">
                <Setter.Value>
                    <ControlTemplate TargetType="ListBoxItem">
                        <ContentPresenter/>
                    </ControlTemplate>
                </Setter.Value>
            </Setter>
        </Style>
    <Style x:Key="AutoImportHealthCardStyle" TargetType="Border" BasedOn="{StaticResource CardBorderStyle}">
 <Setter Property="Margin" Value="0"/><Setter Property="Padding" Value="14,11"/>
 <Style.Triggers>
  <DataTrigger Binding="{Binding AutoImportHealthState}" Value="Green"><Setter Property="Background" Value="#F0FDF4"/><Setter Property="BorderBrush" Value="#22C55E"/></DataTrigger>
  <DataTrigger Binding="{Binding AutoImportHealthState}" Value="Red"><Setter Property="Background" Value="#FEF2F2"/><Setter Property="BorderBrush" Value="#EF4444"/></DataTrigger>
 </Style.Triggers>
</Style><Style x:Key="TallyStatusHealthCardStyle" TargetType="Border">
 <Setter Property="Background" Value="#F8FAFC"/><Setter Property="BorderBrush" Value="#D8E0EB"/><Setter Property="BorderThickness" Value="1"/><Setter Property="CornerRadius" Value="10"/><Setter Property="Padding" Value="12"/>
 <Style.Triggers>
  <DataTrigger Binding="{Binding TallyStatusState}" Value="Green"><Setter Property="Background" Value="#F0FDF4"/><Setter Property="BorderBrush" Value="#22C55E"/></DataTrigger>
  <DataTrigger Binding="{Binding TallyStatusState}" Value="Red"><Setter Property="Background" Value="#FEF2F2"/><Setter Property="BorderBrush" Value="#EF4444"/></DataTrigger>
 </Style.Triggers>
</Style><Style x:Key="TallyExportHealthCardStyle" TargetType="Border" BasedOn="{StaticResource InnerCardStyle}">
 <Setter Property="Margin" Value="0"/><Setter Property="Padding" Value="12"/>
 <Style.Triggers>
  <DataTrigger Binding="{Binding TallyExportHealthState}" Value="Green"><Setter Property="Background" Value="#F0FDF4"/><Setter Property="BorderBrush" Value="#22C55E"/></DataTrigger>
  <DataTrigger Binding="{Binding TallyExportHealthState}" Value="Red"><Setter Property="Background" Value="#FEF2F2"/><Setter Property="BorderBrush" Value="#EF4444"/></DataTrigger>
 </Style.Triggers>
</Style></UserControl.Resources>

    <ScrollViewer x:Name="DashboardScrollViewer" VerticalScrollBarVisibility="Auto" HorizontalScrollBarVisibility="Disabled" Background="{DynamicResource AppBackgroundBrush}" ScrollChanged="DashboardScrollViewer_ScrollChanged">
        <StackPanel Margin="20,20,20,28">
            <Border Style="{StaticResource CardBorderStyle}" Margin="0,0,0,12">
                <Grid>
                    <Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
                        <ColumnDefinition Width="Auto"/>
                        <ColumnDefinition Width="*"/>
                        <ColumnDefinition Width="Auto"/>
                    </Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
                    <TextBlock Text="All Search" FontWeight="SemiBold" VerticalAlignment="Center" Margin="0,0,14,0"/>
                    <ComboBox x:Name="AllSearchBox" Grid.Column="1" IsEditable="True" IsTextSearchEnabled="False" StaysOpenOnEdit="True"
                              DisplayMemberPath="DisplayText" KeyDown="AllSearchBox_KeyDown" MinWidth="260"
                              ToolTip="Search everything in this Client/FY: modules, Ledger/Group Masters, Stock Items/aliases/units/conversions, Purchase/Sales invoices and vouchers, Journal vouchers/mappings, Bank statements/transactions/reconciliation/transfers/mappings, Cash, GST returns/ledgers/Nil periods, 26AS, statements and Action rows"/>
                    <Button Grid.Column="2" Content="Go" Click="AllSearchGo_Click" Style="{StaticResource DashboardSecondaryButtonStyle}" Margin="10,0,0,0"/>
                </Grid>
            </Border>
            <Border Style="{StaticResource CardBorderStyle}">
                <StackPanel>
                    <Grid>
                        <Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
                            <ColumnDefinition Width="*"/>
                            <ColumnDefinition Width="Auto"/>
                        </Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
                        <TextBlock Text="Client Identity" Style="{StaticResource SectionTitleStyle}" Margin="0"/>
                        <WrapPanel Grid.Column="1" HorizontalAlignment="Right">
                            <Button Content="Open / Link Folder" Command="{Binding OpenLinkedFolderCommand}" Style="{StaticResource DashboardSecondaryButtonStyle}" Margin="0,0,8,0" ToolTip="Open the linked folder. If it moved, locate and recover it; if no folder is linked, link one to this Client/FY."/><Button Content="Generate Excel" Command="{Binding ExportDiagnosticExcelCommand}" Style="{StaticResource DashboardSecondaryButtonStyle}" Margin="0,0,8,0"/>
                            <Button Content="Generate CSV" Command="{Binding ExportDiagnosticCsvCommand}" Style="{StaticResource DashboardSecondaryButtonStyle}" Margin="0,0,8,0"/>
                            <Button Content="Clear All Data" Command="{Binding ClearAllDataCommand}" Padding="13,8" FontWeight="SemiBold" Cursor="Hand" Background="#FEF2F2" Foreground="#B91C1C" BorderBrush="#FCA5A5" BorderThickness="1" ToolTip="Clear all accounting/module data for the selected Client/FY while preserving the Client, Settings, Automation Folder and Tally link"/>
                        </WrapPanel>
                    </Grid>
                    <Grid Margin="0,12,0,0">
                        <Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
                            <ColumnDefinition Width="110"/>
                            <ColumnDefinition Width="*"/>
                            <ColumnDefinition Width="18"/>
                            <ColumnDefinition Width="110"/>
                            <ColumnDefinition Width="*"/>
                        </Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
                        <Grid.RowDefinitions>
                            <RowDefinition Height="Auto"/>
                            <RowDefinition Height="Auto"/>
                            <RowDefinition Height="Auto"/>
                            <RowDefinition Height="Auto"/>
                        </Grid.RowDefinitions>
                        <TextBlock Grid.Row="0" Text="Client Name" Foreground="{DynamicResource TextSecondaryBrush}" Margin="0,0,0,9"/>
                        <TextBox Grid.Row="0" Grid.Column="1" Text="{Binding ClientName, Mode=OneWay}" FontWeight="SemiBold" TextWrapping="Wrap" Margin="0,0,0,9" IsReadOnly="True" BorderThickness="0" Background="Transparent" Padding="0"/>
                        <TextBlock Grid.Row="0" Grid.Column="3" Text="GSTIN" Foreground="{DynamicResource TextSecondaryBrush}" Margin="0,0,0,9"/>
                        <TextBox Grid.Row="0" Grid.Column="4" Text="{Binding Gstin, Mode=OneWay}" Margin="0,0,0,9" IsReadOnly="True" BorderThickness="0" Background="Transparent" Padding="0"/>

                        <TextBlock Grid.Row="1" Text="Trade Name" Foreground="{DynamicResource TextSecondaryBrush}" Margin="0,0,0,9"/>
                        <TextBox Grid.Row="1" Grid.Column="1" Text="{Binding TradeName, Mode=OneWay}" TextWrapping="Wrap" Margin="0,0,0,9" IsReadOnly="True" BorderThickness="0" Background="Transparent" Padding="0"/>
                        <TextBlock Grid.Row="1" Grid.Column="3" Text="PAN" Foreground="{DynamicResource TextSecondaryBrush}" Margin="0,0,0,9"/>
                        <TextBox Grid.Row="1" Grid.Column="4" Text="{Binding Pan, Mode=OneWay}" Margin="0,0,0,9" IsReadOnly="True" BorderThickness="0" Background="Transparent" Padding="0"/>

                        <TextBlock Grid.Row="2" Text="Legal Name" Foreground="{DynamicResource TextSecondaryBrush}" Margin="0,0,0,9"/>
                        <TextBox Grid.Row="2" Grid.Column="1" Text="{Binding LegalName, Mode=OneWay}" TextWrapping="Wrap" Margin="0,0,0,9" IsReadOnly="True" BorderThickness="0" Background="Transparent" Padding="0"/>
                        <TextBlock Grid.Row="2" Grid.Column="3" Text="State" Foreground="{DynamicResource TextSecondaryBrush}" Margin="0,0,0,9"/>
                        <TextBox Grid.Row="2" Grid.Column="4" Text="{Binding State, Mode=OneWay}" Margin="0,0,0,9" IsReadOnly="True" BorderThickness="0" Background="Transparent" Padding="0"/>

                        <TextBlock Grid.Row="3" Text="Contact" Foreground="{DynamicResource TextSecondaryBrush}"/>
                        <TextBox Grid.Row="3" Grid.Column="1" Text="{Binding ContactText, Mode=OneWay}" TextWrapping="Wrap" IsReadOnly="True" BorderThickness="0" Background="Transparent" Padding="0"/>
                        <TextBlock Grid.Row="3" Grid.Column="3" Text="Address" Foreground="{DynamicResource TextSecondaryBrush}"/>
                        <TextBox Grid.Row="3" Grid.Column="4" Text="{Binding AddressText, Mode=OneWay}" TextWrapping="Wrap" IsReadOnly="True" BorderThickness="0" Background="Transparent" Padding="0"/>
                    </Grid>
                    <TextBlock Text="{Binding DiagnosticExportStatus}" Foreground="{DynamicResource TextSecondaryBrush}" FontSize="9" TextWrapping="Wrap" Margin="0,10,0,0"/>
                </StackPanel>
            </Border>

            <Border Margin="0,14,0,0" Style="{StaticResource CardBorderStyle}" AllowDrop="True" DragOver="UniversalDumpTile_DragOver" Drop="UniversalDumpTile_Drop" MouseLeftButtonUp="UniversalDumpTile_Click" Cursor="Hand" ToolTip="Drop supported files or folders here. AAH will classify and route them through Universal Dump.">
                <Grid MinHeight="104">
                    <Grid.ColumnDefinitions><ColumnDefinition Width="Auto"/><ColumnDefinition Width="*"/><ColumnDefinition Width="Auto"/></Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
                    <Border Width="64" Height="64" CornerRadius="14" Background="{DynamicResource AccentSoftBrush}" VerticalAlignment="Center" Margin="0,0,14,0">
                        <TextBlock Text="⇩" FontSize="32" FontWeight="Bold" Foreground="{DynamicResource AccentBrush}" HorizontalAlignment="Center" VerticalAlignment="Center"/>
                    </Border>
                    <StackPanel Grid.Column="1" VerticalAlignment="Center">
                        <TextBlock Text="UNIVERSAL DUMP" FontSize="16" FontWeight="SemiBold"/>
                        <TextBlock Text="Drop mixed Bank / GST / Purchase / Sales / Cash / Journal files here" Foreground="{DynamicResource TextSecondaryBrush}" Margin="0,4,0,0"/>
                        <TextBlock Text="AAH classifies locally and routes each supported file to the correct module." FontSize="10" Foreground="{DynamicResource TextSecondaryBrush}" Margin="0,2,0,0"/>
                    </StackPanel>
                    <StackPanel Grid.Column="2" Orientation="Horizontal" VerticalAlignment="Center">
                        <Button Content="Import Accounting Workbook" Click="AccountingWorkbook_Click" Style="{StaticResource DashboardSecondaryButtonStyle}" Padding="12,8" Margin="0,0,8,0" ToolTip="Import the linked multi-module Accounting Workbook (Master, Bank, Ledger Mapping, Sales/Credit Note, Purchase/Debit Note and Journal) in dependency order."/>
                        <Button Content="Browse Files / Folder" Click="UniversalDump_Click" Style="{StaticResource PrimaryButtonStyle}" Padding="14,8"/>
                    </StackPanel>
                </Grid>
            </Border>

            <Grid Margin="0,14,0,0">
 <Grid.ColumnDefinitions><ColumnDefinition Width="*"/><ColumnDefinition Width="12"/><ColumnDefinition Width="*"/></Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
<Border Margin="0" Style="{StaticResource CardBorderStyle}" Grid.Column="0">
                <StackPanel>
                    <TextBlock Text="Accounting Activity" Style="{StaticResource SectionTitleStyle}"/>
                    <ItemsControl ItemsSource="{Binding AccountingSummaryMetrics}">
                        <ItemsControl.ItemsPanel><ItemsPanelTemplate><UniformGrid Columns="2"/></ItemsPanelTemplate></ItemsControl.ItemsPanel><ItemsControl.ItemTemplate>
                            <DataTemplate>
                                <Border MinHeight="92" Margin="4" Padding="9" CornerRadius="8" Cursor="Hand" MouseLeftButtonUp="AccountingMetric_MouseLeftButtonUp">
                                    <Border.Style>
                                        <Style TargetType="Border">
                                            <Setter Property="Background" Value="{DynamicResource AppBackgroundBrush}"/>
                                            <Setter Property="BorderBrush" Value="{DynamicResource BorderBrush}"/>
                                            <Setter Property="BorderThickness" Value="1"/>
                                            <Style.Triggers>
                                                <DataTrigger Binding="{Binding StatusState}" Value="Grey"><Setter Property="Background" Value="#F8FAFC"/><Setter Property="BorderBrush" Value="#CBD5E1"/></DataTrigger><DataTrigger Binding="{Binding StatusState}" Value="Green"><Setter Property="Background" Value="#F0FDF4"/><Setter Property="BorderBrush" Value="#86EFAC"/></DataTrigger><DataTrigger Binding="{Binding HasActionRequired}" Value="True">
                                                    <Setter Property="Background" Value="{DynamicResource ActionRequiredSoftBrush}"/>
                                                    <Setter Property="BorderBrush" Value="{DynamicResource ActionRequiredBrush}"/>
                                                </DataTrigger>
                                            </Style.Triggers>
                                        </Style>
                                    </Border.Style>
                                    <Grid>
 <StackPanel Margin="1">
  <TextBlock Text="{Binding Label}" FontSize="10" Foreground="{DynamicResource TextSecondaryBrush}"/>
  <TextBlock Text="{Binding Value, StringFormat={}{0:N0}}" FontSize="21" FontWeight="SemiBold" Margin="0,4,0,0"/>
  <TextBlock Text="{Binding Detail}" FontSize="9" Foreground="{DynamicResource TextSecondaryBrush}" TextWrapping="Wrap" Margin="0,3,0,0"/>
  <Button Margin="0,4,0,0" Padding="0" Background="Transparent" BorderThickness="0" HorizontalContentAlignment="Left"
          Foreground="{DynamicResource AccentBrush}" Cursor="Hand" Click="BankPendingMapping_Click"
          Visibility="{Binding IsBankStatementMetric, Converter={StaticResource BooleanToVisibilityConverter}}"
          ToolTip="Open Banking directly in Ledger Mapping Pending view">
   <TextBlock FontSize="9" FontWeight="SemiBold"><Run Text="Ledger Mapping"/><Run Text=" • "/><Run Text="{Binding PendingMappingCount, Mode=OneWay}"/><Run Text=" Pending →"/></TextBlock>
  </Button>
  <Button Margin="0,3,0,0" Padding="0" Background="Transparent" BorderThickness="0" HorizontalContentAlignment="Left" Foreground="{DynamicResource ActionRequiredBrush}" Cursor="Hand" Click="AccountingActionRequired_Click" Visibility="{Binding HasActionRequired, Converter={StaticResource BooleanToVisibilityConverter}}" ToolTip="Open Action Center and see exactly what needs attention">
   <TextBlock FontSize="9" FontWeight="SemiBold"><Run Text="View action required: "/><Run Text="{Binding ActionRequiredCount, Mode=OneWay}"/></TextBlock>
  </Button>
 </StackPanel>
</Grid></Border>
                            </DataTemplate>
                        </ItemsControl.ItemTemplate>
                    </ItemsControl>

                    <Border Margin="4,8,4,4" Padding="10" CornerRadius="8" Background="{DynamicResource AppBackgroundBrush}" BorderBrush="{DynamicResource BorderBrush}" BorderThickness="1">
                        <Grid>
                            <Grid.ColumnDefinitions><ColumnDefinition Width="*"/><ColumnDefinition Width="Auto"/></Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
                            <StackPanel>
                                <TextBlock Text="Financial Statements" FontSize="12" FontWeight="SemiBold"/>
                                <TextBlock Text="Toggle a report on only when needed. It appears in the sidebar but is generated only when you open it." FontSize="9" Foreground="{DynamicResource TextSecondaryBrush}" TextWrapping="Wrap" Margin="0,2,12,0"/>
                            </StackPanel>
                            <StackPanel Grid.Column="1" Orientation="Horizontal" VerticalAlignment="Center">
                                <ToggleButton x:Name="BalanceSheetToggle" Content="Balance Sheet" Click="FinancialStatementToggle_Click" Tag="Balance Sheet" Padding="10,5" Margin="0,0,6,0"/>
                                <ToggleButton x:Name="ProfitLossToggle" Content="P&L" Click="FinancialStatementToggle_Click" Tag="P&L" Padding="10,5"/>
                            </StackPanel>
                        </Grid>
                    </Border>

                </StackPanel>
            </Border>

            <Border Margin="0" Style="{StaticResource AutoImportHealthCardStyle}" Grid.Column="2" VerticalAlignment="Top">
                <StackPanel>
                    <Grid>
                        <Grid.ColumnDefinitions><ColumnDefinition Width="*"/><ColumnDefinition Width="Auto"/></Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
                        <StackPanel>
                            <TextBlock Text="Auto Import Activity" Style="{StaticResource SectionTitleStyle}" Margin="0"/>
                            <TextBlock Text="{Binding AutoImportSummary}" Foreground="{DynamicResource TextSecondaryBrush}" FontSize="10" Margin="0,3,0,0" TextWrapping="Wrap"/>
                        </StackPanel>
                        <Button Grid.Column="1" Content="Auto Import From Folder" Command="{Binding AutoImportFromFolderCommand}" Style="{StaticResource DashboardSecondaryButtonStyle}" Padding="10,5"/>
                    </Grid>

                    <StackPanel Orientation="Horizontal" Margin="0,6,0,0"><TextBlock Text="Files imported: " FontSize="9" Foreground="{DynamicResource TextSecondaryBrush}"/><TextBlock Text="{Binding AutoImportSuccessfulFiles, StringFormat={}{0:N0}}" FontSize="9" Foreground="{DynamicResource TextSecondaryBrush}"/></StackPanel><StackPanel Orientation="Horizontal" Margin="0,1,0,0"><TextBlock Text="Transactions imported: " FontSize="9"/><TextBlock Text="{Binding AutoImportTransactionCount, StringFormat={}{0:N0}}" FontSize="9" FontWeight="SemiBold"/></StackPanel><ItemsControl ItemsSource="{Binding AutoImportSummaryMetrics}" Margin="0,9,0,0">
                        <ItemsControl.ItemsPanel><ItemsPanelTemplate><UniformGrid Columns="1"/></ItemsPanelTemplate></ItemsControl.ItemsPanel><ItemsControl.ItemTemplate>
                            <DataTemplate>
                                <Border MinHeight="74" Margin="4" Padding="9" CornerRadius="8" Background="{DynamicResource AppBackgroundBrush}" BorderBrush="{DynamicResource BorderBrush}" BorderThickness="1" Cursor="Hand" MouseLeftButtonUp="AccountingMetric_MouseLeftButtonUp" ToolTip="Open this module">
                                    <StackPanel>
                                        <TextBlock Text="{Binding Label}" FontSize="10" Foreground="{DynamicResource TextSecondaryBrush}"/>
                                        <TextBlock Text="{Binding Value, StringFormat={}{0:N0}}" FontSize="21" FontWeight="SemiBold" Margin="0,3,0,0"/>
                                        <TextBlock Text="{Binding Detail}" FontSize="9" Foreground="{DynamicResource TextSecondaryBrush}" TextWrapping="Wrap" Margin="0,2,0,0"/>
                                    </StackPanel>
                                </Border>
                            </DataTemplate>
                        </ItemsControl.ItemTemplate>
                    </ItemsControl>

                    <Grid Margin="0,4,0,0" Visibility="{Binding IsAutoImportActive, Converter={StaticResource BooleanToVisibilityConverter}}">
                        <Grid.ColumnDefinitions><ColumnDefinition Width="*"/><ColumnDefinition Width="Auto"/></Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
                        <ProgressBar Height="10" Minimum="0" Maximum="100" Value="{Binding AutoImportProgressPercent, Mode=OneWay}"/>
                        <TextBlock Grid.Column="1" Text="{Binding AutoImportProgressPercent, Mode=OneWay, StringFormat={}{0:0}%}" Margin="8,-3,0,0" FontWeight="SemiBold"/>
                    </Grid>
                    <TextBlock Text="{Binding AutoImportFolderStatus}" Foreground="{DynamicResource TextSecondaryBrush}" FontSize="9" Margin="0,4,0,0" TextTrimming="CharacterEllipsis"/>
                </StackPanel>
            </Border>

            </Grid>

            <Border Margin="0,14,0,0" Style="{StaticResource CardBorderStyle}"
                    Visibility="{Binding HasValidGstin, Converter={StaticResource BooleanToVisibilityConverter}}">
                <StackPanel>
                    <Grid Margin="0,0,0,6">
                        <Grid.ColumnDefinitions><ColumnDefinition Width="*"/><ColumnDefinition Width="Auto"/></Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
                        <TextBlock Text="GSTR-3B Matching" Style="{StaticResource SectionTitleStyle}" Margin="0"/>
                        <StackPanel Grid.Column="1" Orientation="Horizontal">
                            <TextBlock Text="●" Foreground="#22C55E" Margin="0,0,3,0"/><TextBlock Text="Matched" FontSize="10" Foreground="{DynamicResource TextSecondaryBrush}" Margin="0,0,8,0"/>
                            <TextBlock Text="●" Foreground="#EF4444" Margin="0,0,3,0"/><TextBlock Text="Review" FontSize="10" Foreground="{DynamicResource TextSecondaryBrush}" Margin="0,0,8,0"/>
                            <TextBlock Text="●" Foreground="#9CA3AF" Margin="0,0,3,0"/><TextBlock Text="No data" FontSize="10" Foreground="{DynamicResource TextSecondaryBrush}"/>
                        </StackPanel>
                    </Grid>
                    <ItemsControl ItemsSource="{Binding Gstr3bMonthTiles}">
                        <ItemsControl.ItemsPanel><ItemsPanelTemplate><WrapPanel/></ItemsPanelTemplate></ItemsControl.ItemsPanel>
                        <ItemsControl.ItemTemplate>
                            <DataTemplate>
                                <Border Style="{StaticResource PeriodDisplayTileStyle}" Cursor="Hand" MouseLeftButtonUp="Gstr3bMonth_MouseLeftButtonUp" ToolTip="{Binding Detail}">
                                    <TextBlock Text="{Binding Month}" FontWeight="SemiBold" HorizontalAlignment="Center" VerticalAlignment="Center" Margin="0,2"/>
                                </Border>
                            </DataTemplate>
                        </ItemsControl.ItemTemplate>
                    </ItemsControl>
                </StackPanel>
            </Border>

            <Border Margin="0,14,0,0" Style="{StaticResource CardBorderStyle}">
                <StackPanel>
                    <Grid>
                        <Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
                            <ColumnDefinition Width="*"/>
                            <ColumnDefinition Width="Auto"/>
                        </Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
                        <StackPanel>
                            <TextBlock Text="Tally" Style="{StaticResource SectionTitleStyle}" Margin="0"/>
                            <TextBlock Text="{Binding TallyConnectionStatus}" Foreground="{DynamicResource TextSecondaryBrush}" FontSize="11" Margin="0,4,0,0"/>
                            <TextBlock Text="{Binding TallyLiveXmlStatus}" Foreground="{DynamicResource TextSecondaryBrush}" FontSize="10" Margin="0,3,0,0" TextTrimming="CharacterEllipsis" ToolTip="{Binding TallyLiveXmlStatus}"/>
                        </StackPanel>
                        <Button Grid.Column="1" Content="Refresh Tally" Command="{Binding RefreshTallyCommand}" Style="{StaticResource DashboardSecondaryButtonStyle}"/>
                    </Grid>

$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
$Root = Split-Path -Parent $PSScriptRoot
. (Join-Path $PSScriptRoot 'Compat-R24ExactProof.ps1')
$Utf8 = New-Object -TypeName System.Text.UTF8Encoding -ArgumentList $false,$true
function Read-F31([string]$Rel) {
    $path = Join-Path $Root $Rel
    if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $path -PathType Leaf)) { throw ('R52 FIXED31 file missing: ' + $Rel) }
    [IO.File]::ReadAllText($path, $Utf8)
}
function Req([bool]$ok, [string]$message) { if (-not $ok) { throw $message } }
function Hash-F31([string]$Text) {
    $sha = [Security.Cryptography.SHA256]::Create()
    try { return ([BitConverter]::ToString($sha.ComputeHash($Utf8.GetBytes($Text)))).Replace('-', '').ToLowerInvariant() }
    finally { $sha.Dispose() }
}
function Undo-Repair19CoordinatorExtension([string]$CurrentText) {
    $CurrentText = Undo-R24ApprovedSource 'src/AccountingAutomationHub.Desktop/Services/TallyLiveConnectionCoordinator.cs' $CurrentText
    $approved = [IO.File]::ReadAllText((Join-Path $Root 'Tests\AAH.TallyInventory.Tests\FIXED41R8R19CoordinatorLaunchProof.json'), $Utf8) | ConvertFrom-Json
    $entry = @($approved.files | Where-Object { [string]$_.name -eq 'coordinator' })
    if ($entry.Count -ne 1) { throw 'Repair 19 coordinator source proof is missing or ambiguous.' }
    $proof = $entry[0]
    if ((Hash-F31 $CurrentText) -ne [string]$proof.current_text_sha256) { throw 'Repair 19 current coordinator differs from the exact approved linked-Tally launcher extension.' }
    foreach ($part in @($proof.changes)) {
        $after = [string]$part.after
        if ([string]::IsNullOrEmpty($after)) { throw 'Repair 19 approved coordinator replacement is empty.' }
        if (([regex]::Matches($CurrentText, [regex]::Escape($after))).Count -ne 1) { throw 'Repair 19 approved coordinator replacement is missing or duplicated.' }
        $CurrentText = $CurrentText.Replace($after, [string]$part.before)
    }
    if ((Hash-F31 $CurrentText) -ne [string]$proof.baseline_text_sha256) { throw 'Repair 19 coordinator does not reverse exactly to the approved FIXED41 coordinator.' }
    return $CurrentText
}
function Undo-Fixed41CoordinatorExtension([string]$CurrentText) {
    $approved = Read-F31 'Tests\AAH.TallyInventory.Tests\FIXED41CoordinatorApprovedChanges.json' | ConvertFrom-Json
    $entry = @($approved.files | Where-Object { [string]$_.name -eq 'coordinator' })
    Req ($entry.Count -eq 1) 'FIXED41 coordinator source proof is missing or ambiguous.'
    $proof = $entry[0]
    Req ((Hash-F31 $CurrentText) -eq [string]$proof.current_text_sha256) 'FIXED41 current coordinator differs from the exact approved extension.'
    foreach ($part in @($proof.changes)) {
        $after = [string]$part.after
        Req (-not [string]::IsNullOrEmpty($after)) 'FIXED41 approved coordinator replacement is empty.'
        Req (([regex]::Matches($CurrentText, [regex]::Escape($after))).Count -eq 1) 'FIXED41 approved coordinator replacement is missing or duplicated.'
        $CurrentText = $CurrentText.Replace($after, [string]$part.before)
    }
    Req ((Hash-F31 $CurrentText) -eq [string]$proof.baseline_text_sha256) 'FIXED41 coordinator does not reverse exactly to FIXED40.'
    return $CurrentText
}
function Undo-Fixed40CoordinatorExtension([string]$CurrentText) {
    $approved = Read-F31 'Tests\AAH.TallyInventory.Tests\FIXED40CoordinatorApprovedChanges.json' | ConvertFrom-Json
    $entry = @($approved.files | Where-Object { [string]$_.name -eq 'coordinator' })
    Req ($entry.Count -eq 1) 'FIXED40 coordinator source proof is missing or ambiguous.'
    $proof = $entry[0]
    Req ((Hash-F31 $CurrentText) -eq [string]$proof.current_text_sha256) 'FIXED40 current coordinator does not match the approved exact hash.'
    foreach ($part in @($proof.changes)) {
        $after = [string]$part.after
        Req (-not [string]::IsNullOrEmpty($after)) 'FIXED40 approved coordinator replacement is empty.'
        Req (([regex]::Matches($CurrentText, [regex]::Escape($after))).Count -eq 1) 'FIXED40 approved coordinator replacement is missing or duplicated.'
        $CurrentText = $CurrentText.Replace($after, [string]$part.before)
    }
    Req ((Hash-F31 $CurrentText) -eq [string]$proof.baseline_text_sha256) 'FIXED40 coordinator does not reverse exactly to FIXED39.'
    return $CurrentText
}

    $r22 = Read-F31 'Installer\Verify-Fix137R22.ps1'
